-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.RestoreVocab` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem mvcc.nJobRd_off (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) (h : ¬mvcc.kbCmpM kb) : mvcc.nJobRd kb = 0

theorem mvcc.kbRecs_MWf (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) (γb : GName) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : mvcc.kbRecs kb
    γb r ⊢ mvcc.kbMWf kb γb

theorem mvcc.kbNoDelOff_off (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) (h : ¬mvcc.kbCmpM kb) : mvcc.kbNoDelOff kb =
    mvcc.kbNoDel kb

def backend.fkVM (γ : backend.BNames) (w : Bool) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ n v, backend.fkVD γ w n v)

def mvcc.restoreRcptM (d' : mvcc.KBReal) (L : mvcc.Log) : IProp GF :=
  if d'.cm = true then ⧖(mvcc.logCh L) else iprop(True)

theorem mvcc.restoreRegM_fix (d' : mvcc.KBReal) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : mvcc.restoreRegM d' ⊢ |==> □
    mvcc.restoreFixM d' γ

theorem mvcc.storeBackendTR_empty (b : GoInterface) (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) :
    mvcc.storeBackendTR b s γ P mvcc.CmpRecs.empty = mvcc.storeBackendT b s γ P

def mvcc.restoreRegM (d' : mvcc.KBReal) : IProp GF :=
  if d'.cm = true then backend.dlInit d'.γB else iprop(True)

theorem mvcc.restoreRightM_off (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) (h : ¬mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb) :
    mvcc.restoreRightM s γ c ⊣⊢ mvcc.storeCloser s γ ∗ mvcc.crevFrozen γ ∗ ⌜c = -1⌝

theorem mvcc.compactJobResM_off (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) (h : ¬mvcc.kbCmpM kb) :
    mvcc.compactJobResM kb = iprop(True)

theorem mvcc.kbRecs_empty (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) (γb : GName) : mvcc.kbRecs kb γb
    mvcc.CmpRecs.empty = mvcc.kbNoCmpF kb γb

def mvcc.restoreImageM (d' : mvcc.KBReal) (γb' : GName) (L : mvcc.Log) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : IProp GF
    :=
  if d'.cm = true then
    iprop(∃ ents,
        mvcc.kbViewC (some d') γb' 1 (mvcc.bucketOfEnts ents) ∗
          (mvcc.kbRecs (some d') γb' r ∗ mvcc.kbVals (some d') (mvcc.recBytes r.fin, mvcc.recBytes r.sched) ∅) ∗
            backend.fkVM d'.γB true ∗ ⌜mvcc.recsOk L r ∧ mvcc.recsPos r ∧ mvcc.entsCutAt L r.crev ents⌝)
  else iprop(mvcc.kbViewC (some d') γb' 1 (mvcc.bucketMap L) ∗ mvcc.kbNoCmp (some d') γb' ∗ ⌜r = mvcc.CmpRecs.empty⌝)

theorem mvcc.restoreImageM_off (d' : mvcc.KBReal) (γb' : GName) (L : mvcc.Log) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) (h
    : d'.cm = false) : mvcc.restoreImageM d' γb' L r ⊣⊢ mvcc.kbViewC (some d') γb' 1 (mvcc.bucketMap
    L) ∗ mvcc.kbNoCmp (some d') γb' ∗ ⌜r = mvcc.CmpRecs.empty⌝

theorem mvcc.restoreRcptM_off (d' : mvcc.KBReal) (L : mvcc.Log) (h : d'.cm = false) :
    mvcc.restoreRcptM d' L = iprop(True)

def mvcc.restoreRightM (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) : IProp GF :=
  if mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb then mvcc.compactRightR s γ c else iprop(mvcc.storeCloser s γ ∗ mvcc.crevFrozen γ ∗ ⌜c = -1⌝)

def backend.fkVD (γ : backend.BNames) (w : Bool) (n : Nat) (v : Option GoString × Option GoString) :
    IProp GF :=
  dghostVar γ.fkv DFrac.discard (w, n, v)

theorem mvcc.cmOff_true (d : mvcc.KBReal) (hcm : d.cm = false) : ¬mvcc.kbCmpM (some d) ∧ mvcc.nJobRd
    (some d) = 0 ∧ mvcc.kbSRM (some d) = iprop(True) ∧ mvcc.kbWTSupplyM (some d) = iprop(True) ∧
    mvcc.compactJobResM (some d) = iprop(True)

def mvcc.storeBackendTR (b : GoInterface) (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (P : IProp GF) (r :
    mvcc.CmpRecs) : IProp GF :=
  mvcc.isKeyBackendGR b (mvcc.bucketView γ) (mvcc.storeRT γ) (mvcc.storeWT γ) (mvcc.kbRecs γ.kb γ.bucket r) r
    (mvcc.storePutOk γ) (mvcc.delKey γ) (mvcc.storeW s γ) (mvcc.kbWi γ.kb) iprop(True) (mvcc.storeCmp γ) P (mvcc.hookFn γ)
    (mvcc.storeReq γ) (mvcc.storeRb γ) (mvcc.storeBt γ) (mvcc.kbSR γ.kb) (mvcc.kbSRh γ.kb) (mvcc.kbMWv γ.kb γ.bucket)
    (mvcc.kbHookNilAt γ.kb)

theorem mvcc.restoreRightM_on (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) (h : mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb) :
    mvcc.restoreRightM s γ c ⊣⊢ mvcc.compactRightR s γ c

def backend.fkOpenD (γ : backend.BNames) (n : Nat) (v : Option GoString × Option GoString) : IProp
    GF :=
  iprop(∃ w, backend.fkVD γ w n v)

theorem mvcc.restoreRcptM_persistent (d' : mvcc.KBReal) (L : mvcc.Log) : Persistent
    (mvcc.restoreRcptM d' L)

theorem mvcc.restoreFixM_off (d' : mvcc.KBReal) (h : d'.cm = false) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) :
    mvcc.restoreFixM d' γ = iprop(True)

theorem backend.fkOpenD_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (n : Nat) (v : Option GoString × Option
    GoString) : Persistent (backend.fkOpenD γ n v)

theorem mvcc.restoreRcptM_on (d' : mvcc.KBReal) (L : mvcc.Log) (h : d'.cm = true) :
    mvcc.restoreRcptM d' L ⊣⊢ ⧖(mvcc.logCh L)

def mvcc.kbRecs (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) (γb : GName) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : IProp GF :=
  if r = mvcc.CmpRecs.empty then mvcc.kbNoCmpF kb γb
  else
    match kb with
    | none => iprop(False)
    | some d => iprop(∃ n, backend.fkFlag d.γB n ∗ backend.fkOpenD d.γB n (mvcc.recBytes r.fin, mvcc.recBytes r.sched))

def mvcc.restoreFixM (d' : mvcc.KBReal) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  if d'.cm = true then mvcc.storeDlReg d'.γB γ.idx else iprop(True)

theorem backend.fkVD_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (w : Bool) (n : Nat) (v : Option GoString ×
    Option GoString) : Persistent (backend.fkVD γ w n v)

theorem mvcc.restoreRegM_off (d' : mvcc.KBReal) (h : d'.cm = false) : mvcc.restoreRegM d' =
    iprop(True)
